verdict.rationale: The skills CLI documents several bulk operations. You can install all skills from a repo with `'*'`, select multiple skills with repeated `--skill` flags, and target several agents at once with `-a claude-code -a opencode`. `skills update` updates every installed skill when given no arguments or several named ones, `remove` acts across multiple agents in one command, `experimental_install` restores everything from skills-lock.json, and `-y` runs non-interactively for CI. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent corroboration that the bulk flags work at scale; explicit documentation of removing many skills at once; any bulk path outside the CLI (e.g. API-driven batch operations).
